rule: A piece is one word, so the first word of a folder name is always the piece.
A variant is one term in kebab-case: one word where the idea has one, the wire name where a wire field is what varies, and a second word where the case varies a second thing.
The name says what the request does. One request has one name on every model; what each model answers is the entry's outcome.
A case with name null shows nothing a piece needs; `nothing` says why and `see` names the case of the same offering that shows what it was meant to.

nothing.superseded: an earlier run whose request or answer lacks the reasoning the case is about; a later run carries the name
nothing.defective: the request does not hold what the case is named for, or holds a second setting that was rejected first
nothing.duplicate: the same request as another case of the offering, or the same apart from the output limit; where the outcome differs, `why` gives the cause
nothing.unanswered: no response body, or no data frame in it
nothing.outside: a request field of a piece the table leaves out

variants.other: the same key sent to the provider's other host

variants.header: the key alone in a header of its own, other than the offering's usual one (`x-api-key` or `api-key`)

variants.beta: a feature-switch header naming a real switch, sent to an endpoint that does not document it
variants.binding: the binding control of replayed reasoning sent without its feature switch
variants.effort: an effort carried by an instruction inside the conversation, sent without its feature switch
variants.lifetime: an instruction lifetime sent without its feature switch
variants.pinned: a version header sent to an endpoint that is otherwise called without one
variants.unknown: a feature-switch header naming a switch that does not exist
variants.updates: the `updates` display of reasoning sent without its feature switch

variants.developer: base instructions as a first message of role `developer`
variants.parts: base instructions as an array of text parts
variants.string: base instructions as one string in the format's own field
variants.system: base instructions as a first message of role `system`

variants.declaration: an instruction that adds one tool declaration and removes another
variants.developer-interposed: the same as `interposed` with the role `developer`
variants.developer-last: the same as `last` with the role `developer`
variants.developer-middle: the same as `middle` with the role `developer`
variants.effort: an instruction that carries no text and sets the effort
variants.effort-off: the same as `effort` with reasoning off and a value that differs from the one at the top of the request
variants.first: an instruction as the first message of the conversation, beside the base instructions
variants.interposed: an instruction between a tool call and its result
variants.last: an instruction after the user turn, at the end
variants.lifetime: an instruction that is cleared at the next user message
variants.middle: an instruction after an assistant turn and before the next user turn
variants.result: an instruction after a tool result, at the end

variants.empty: a user turn whose only text part is the empty string
an assistant turn with tool calls and the empty string as its text
variants.null: an assistant turn with tool calls and `null` as its text

variants.absent: the same tool round with the reasoning left out
variants.declaration: reasoning sent back under a tool declaration that was changed after it was issued
variants.drop: the same as `instructions` while asking the provider to drop a mismatched block
variants.earlier: a finished turn's reasoning kept, followed by a new user turn
variants.earlier-absent: the same finished turn with its reasoning left out
variants.empty: the reasoning text sent back as the empty string
variants.empty-signature: the reasoning sent back with its signature replaced by the empty string
variants.foreign: a tool round answered by another model, reasoning included, sent to this one
variants.foreign-signature: the reasoning sent back with a signature another model issued
variants.instructions: reasoning sent back under base instructions that were changed after it was issued
variants.no-signature: the reasoning sent back with its signature field removed
variants.reject: the same as `instructions` while asking the provider to refuse a mismatch
variants.synthetic: the reasoning text sent back replaced by other text
variants.verbatim: a tool round whose reasoning is sent back exactly as it was received

variants.custom: a tool of the `custom` kind declared and chosen
variants.eager-false: a tool declared with eager input streaming off
variants.eager-true: a tool declared with eager input streaming on
variants.strict-false: a tool declared with strict schema adherence off
variants.strict-invalid: a tool declared strict with a schema that breaks the strict rules
variants.strict-true: a tool declared with strict schema adherence on

variants.allowed: the choice narrowed to a set of tools, the model deciding
variants.allowed-required: the choice narrowed to a set of tools, one of which must be called
variants.auto: the model decides whether to call a tool
variants.named: the model must call the named tool
variants.named-reasoning: the same as `named` with reasoning on
variants.none: the model may call no tool, with tools declared
variants.required: the model must call some tool
variants.required-reasoning: the same as `required` with reasoning on

variants.allowed: a step may hold more than one tool call
variants.single: a step may hold one tool call at most

variants.foreign: a tool call issued by another model, sent to this one with its result

variants.error: a tool result that reports a failed tool
variants.parts: a tool result whose content is an array of text parts, the failure flag set to false where the format has one
variants.string: a tool result whose content is a string

variants.assistant: a conversation that begins with an assistant turn
variants.consecutive: two user turns in a row
variants.interposed: user text between a tool call and its result

variants.adaptive: reasoning on, the model deciding how much
variants.between-tools: no reasoning before the answer, short updates between tool calls
variants.budget: reasoning on with a token budget
variants.enabled: reasoning switched on, with no budget
variants.over: a token budget equal to the output limit
variants.under: a token budget below the documented minimum

variants.between-tools: a display setting sent with the between-tools mode
variants.disabled: a display setting sent with reasoning switched off
variants.updates: reasoning text asked for as updates, with its feature switch where one exists

variants.absent: a long prompt with no cache field at all
variants.assistant: a cache mark on an assistant turn
variants.call: cache marks on a tool call and on its result
variants.choice: the marked request sent again with another tool choice
variants.declaration: a cache mark on a tool declaration
variants.effort: the marked request sent again with an effort added
variants.empty: a mark on an empty text part
variants.explicit: explicit caching asked for, with a mark
variants.explicit-unmarked: explicit caching asked for, with no mark
variants.four-top: four marks and the one at the top of the request
variants.implicit-four: implicit caching asked for, with four marks
variants.implicit-write: implicit caching asked for with a grouping key, first request
variants.inline: the marked request sent again with an effort carried by an instruction inside the conversation
variants.misordered: a shorter lifetime before a longer one
variants.mode: the marked request sent again with another reasoning mode
variants.ordered: a longer lifetime before a shorter one
variants.replay: a cache mark on reasoning that is sent back
variants.retention-24h: the retired retention field with the value `24h`
variants.retention-memory: the retired retention field with its in-memory value
variants.short: a mark on a prefix shorter than the model caches
variants.top: one mark at the top of the request, which stands for the last part
variants.user: a cache mark on a user turn
variants.write: a cache mark on the base instructions, first request

variants.both: the output limit in both the current and the retired field
variants.legacy: the output limit in the retired field of the format
variants.one: an output limit of one token
variants.over: an output limit one above the documented ceiling

variants.combined: a temperature and a `top_p` together, both at 1
variants.temperature-default: the temperature the provider defaults to
variants.temperature-reasoning: a temperature of 0 with reasoning on
variants.top-logprobs: token probabilities asked for with one alternative

variants.one: one stop sequence that the answer contains
variants.string: one stop sequence given as a string, not a list

variants.off-options: streaming declined with stream options sent
variants.usage-absent: streaming with no word on usage

variants.prefill: cut text sent back as the last message
variants.prefill-reasoning: cut text sent back as the last message, with reasoning on
variants.reasoning: an assistant turn that holds reasoning only, followed by a user turn
variants.user: cut text sent back as an assistant turn, followed by a user turn, reasoning on

variants.json: an answer with reasoning, not streamed
a tool call in an answer that is not streamed, with no reasoning before it
variants.reasoned: a tool call in an answer that is not streamed, with reasoning before it

variants.empty: a complete answer with no content and no usage

variants.unauthorized: a key the provider does not accept

variants.reasoned: a stream the reader cut inside text, after its reasoning had closed
variants.reasoning: a stream the reader cut inside reasoning
variants.silent: a stream that sent keep-alive lines only until the reader gave up
variants.text: a stream the reader cut inside text

variants.empty: the binding control sent with nothing to act on
